messages:
incident-bot: [PAGER] High p95 latency detected on /v1/embeddings (eu-west-1). Auto-page sent to #incidents and oncall. Details: error_rate 0.4%, p95 2.8s, throughput stable

alex: seeing the same in the dashboard. Topology shows increased queue depth on embed-prod-2

mira: confirmed. Some customers reporting slow responses (~3s). Not yet 5xx but degraded UX.

oncall-liu: I'm on it — pinging infra to check GPU host load, will gather logs.

sre-mgr: alex/mira, please prepare a quick mitigation plan: fallback model routing + temp scale-up. Decide on status page wording once we know impact window.

alex: mitigation idea: route small payload requests to quantized-embed-v2 (lower throughput but lower latency) and scale embed-prod pool by +2 nodes. Canary route first 5%

mira: agree. Quantized model compatibility checks look good, KV cache will miss for a while. Expected p95 drop to ~700ms for canary.

oncall-liu: infra: host cpu/gpu at 95% on embed-prod-2, some oom_kill traces in dmesg around 10:02 UTC. Spinning new nodes now.

incident-bot: Deploy job started: embed-pool-scaleup @ 10:09 UTC by oncall-liu

alex: starting canary routing now, 5% traffic -> quantized-embed-v2. Watch for increase in token cost and small quality delta.

mira: canary looks stable at 10:12. p95 dropped from 2.8s -> 650ms for canary. No errors.

support-jordan: getting inbound customer messages, tagging priority customers in case we need targeted notifications.

pm-casey: drafting status page and customer note. Suggest wording: "We are investigating higher-than-normal latency for embeddings in eu-west-1. Some requests may experience delays up to several seconds. Mitigation in progress; a subset of traffic is being routed to an alternative model to restore latency while we scale capacity."

sre-mgr: good. Add expected timeframe: "mitigation in place now; full recovery expected within 30-45 minutes while we finish scale-up and drain queues."

alex: rolling full traffic to fallback for small payloads now (10:18). Larger payloads still on primary; autoscale should absorb soon.

oncall-liu: embed-prod pool +2 nodes are healthy and joined at 10:22. Starting graceful drain of queues.

mira: monitoring: global p95 for embeddings eu-west-1 down to 820ms at 10:24. Error rate steady.

incident-bot: Status page update queued: "Partial performance degradation in eu-west-1 embeddings — mitigations applied; ongoing recovery." (to be published pending approval)

pm-casey: customer notification draft (short):

"Hi — we detected elevated latency for embeddings in eu-west-1 starting ~10:00 UTC. We have applied routing mitigations and scaled capacity; performance is returning to normal. No data loss; some users may have seen results delayed by up to ~3s. We expect full recovery within 45 minutes. We'll follow up with a post-incident summary. — Redwood Inference Ops"

support-jordan: pushing that to high-touch customers now. Adding note to support triage to watch for quality regressions from quantized model.

alex: logs snippet from embed-prod-2 just before scale-up:

```
Oct 12 10:02:11 embed-prod-2 kernel: Out of memory: Kill process 12345 (python) total-vm:2048000kB, anon-rss:1800000kB
Oct 12 10:02:12 embed-proxy: warn: request queue depth 312
Oct 12 10:02:15 runtime: p95 latency 2800ms, 4xx 0.02%, 5xx 0.00%
```

oncall-liu: thanks — looks like a mem pressure pattern. We'll add stronger OOM cgroup guard and monitor.

sre-mgr: handoff note for next shift (please include in post-incident): what happened, actions taken, current state, recommended follow-ups:
- Cause hypothesis: memory pressure on embed-prod-2 leading to queueing and higher tail latency
- Mitigations: canary routing to quantized-embed-v2, scaled pool +2 nodes, OOM guards applied
- Current state: latency recovering; p95 ~780-850ms; no ongoing errors
- Follow-ups: run root-cause on memory leak, increase auto-scaling headroom for embeddings in eu-west-1, add alert threshold for queue depth > 200

mira: added follow-up task to infra backlog and assigned to @alex.

incident-bot: Publish status page update? reactions: :thumbsup: to approve

pm-casey: :thumbsup: publishing now.

incident-bot: Status page published at 10:29 UTC: "We experienced partial performance degradation for embeddings in eu-west-1; mitigations applied and service is recovering. A post-incident summary will follow."

support-jordan: notified all affected customers at 10:31. No escalations so far.

alex: closing notes — monitoring for 30m, will reopen if p95 > 1.5s or errors increase. Handoff to night oncall in 20m: @oncall-liu will run through RCA notes.

oncall-liu: acknowledged. Handoff ETA 10:50 UTC.

mira: thanks everyone. Will draft post-incident summary with timelines and attach traces.

sre-mgr: great work. Leaving incident channel open until stable for 30m.

incident-bot: Incident thread archived at 10:50 UTC by incident-bot
